facts.fact: iAfrikan (29 September 2026) reports that in April 2026 the BCEAO told every bank, e-money issuer and payment institution in the eight WAEMU states, Mali included, to be connected to PI-SPI by 30 June 2026, and on 25 June moved the deadline to 30 September 2026 (microfinance 30 June 2027).
